WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
    AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
all_album_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_rate
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT
  a.AlbumId,
  a.average_unit_price,
  a.average_bytes_per_millisecond,
  a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - g.average_rate AS above_all_album_average
FROM album_rates AS a
CROSS JOIN all_album_average AS g
ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
